additional_info.body:
Tanya Meghani was assigned as new Case Manager for case 0484246 .
Link to Case:
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=incident&id=6d331874-081f-48c4-80f6-3ee0a14a67dd

Hello,
Today March 13th, a client attempted to charge on the charger 170002726 but there was no energy delivery. The session was started at 4
:18:27 PM and ended at 4:32:08 PM CU TIME. During that period the charger constantly showed the warnings
"Cu not reachable" followed by "CU up again.
We then rebooted the charger but right after we saw that it was disconnected. The client couldn't start a new session because she saw on the screen "Select charging point" with no options to select.
After a few minutes the charger went in status "faulted", and then it was available again.
On the Sifinity portal the charger is still offline and doesn't let us perform a reboot. But we see that there is another client currently charging correctly on connector 1.
Can you please check the logs?
Thank you
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: ID0484246-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002726] Logs check CRM:02832000884
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the provided information and a detailed investigation of the data recorded between 16:18 and 16:32 CU time on charger
MP / R9 170002726/
ycQiU5
we can confirm that no charging session started during that period, and the charger itself did not report any errors.
Regarding the second session you mentioned, it is correctly recorded later in the logs.
Currently, no errors are present in the system; and the charger is working properly, as shown in the picture:
As in Sifinity no error has been reported for today, and the charger is available:
We encountered a minor issue related to the AC outlet. This problem was subsequently resolved automatically by the charger.
We will continue to monitor the charger's performance over the coming days. Should this issue reoccur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed with closing the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

The charging session started at 16:18 and ended at 16:32 CU time (17:18 - 17:32 Italy Time) on the AC outlet (Connector 3 Type 2).
The recharge was correctly authorized but there was no energy delivery.
What exactly was the problem that occurred on the AC outlet? Could it be related to this failed charging session?
With best regards,
Rosita Abate

additional_info.subject: ID0484246-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002726] Logs check CRM:02832000884
additional_info.body:
Dear,
Thank you for follow-up.
There appears to have been a misunderstanding. In your initial email you stated: “
the session was started at 4:18:27 PM and ended at 4:32:08 PM CU TIME
”. I therefore interpreted “CU” as “Central Europe Time” - which includes Italy - and checked that specific time, as outlined in my prior communication.
Unpon further investigating on the correct time stamp, between 17:18 and 17:32 CET, on charger
MP / R9 170002726/ ycQiU5
, I can corroborate, as previously documented, that minor issues related to the AC outlet were encountered. These problems were immediately resolved after the reboot,  likely indicating they were related to a software bug
.
Over the past few days, we’ve monitored charger
MP / R9 170002726/ ycQiU5
and have not observed a recurrence of the minor issues reported.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns. If not, we will close the ticket within 48 hours.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
